title: Good but tabs were broken
text: Good but tabs were broken. I like this product but it arrived broken. The tabs that stick out on each selection 2 of them were broken. It didn’t seem worth it to ask for another one cause i was afraid it would arrive broken too. I use it and it only has two tabs instead of the 4 it should have.

features: ★EASY TO USE – ONE MAGNET Multiple hint patterns , Rotated easily to display whether the dishes inside your dishwasher are clean or dirty. It’s that simple.
★BIG SIZE – Measures 4 inches round,can be easily seen from across the room, instantly tells you the dishwasher is clean or dirty.
★DECORATIVE - The cute and funny Dog pattern will compliment your kitchen’s decor can be the great choice for Halloween Thanksgiving Christmas gift too.
★PERFECT STICKINESS - This magnet adheres to most dishwashers and strong enough to stay firmly in place without slipping.
★SAFE - Unique magnet holds solid strong but never scratches or damages your dishwasher or other appliances.
description: Are they clean? Are they Dirty? No more guessing and no more excuses with our “Clean /Dirty” dishwasher magnet. This Rotated Dishwasher CLEAN & DIRTY Dishwasher Magnet is the Perfect size, and so easy to use. A simple and trendy addition to any home. Cute and Classy with a Dog Theme will compliment your kitchen’s decor. Rotated dishwasher magnet. A loaded or empty dishwasher is “dirty”. Just flip to “clean” when the dishwasher is started. Premium 45 mil thick magnet. Soft flexible magnet will not damage your appliances. PLEASE NOTE: not all appliances are magnetic, so before ordering you should check your dishwasher and verify that it is magnetic.
